_doc: The consent versions, oldest first (docs/design/38-consent-and-terms.md). The web reads this file (consentVersions.ts) and the API mirrors it in Lotties.Domain.Consents.ConsentVersions; ConsentVersionTests (Lotties.Domain.Tests) and consentVersions.test.ts (web) fail when they disagree. Add an entry at the end for every change of meaning of the terms, the privacy policy or the consent screen; never edit or remove one. material: everyone must accept again; false: a dismissible notice. textDigest: the digest of the texts at that version, checked only for the last entry (consentVersions.test.ts prints the new one).
